source_message.text: Put everything apart from Shopline at around 300$, and then handle Shopline afterward. How long would developing Shopline take? Another very important point is that the Avelin AI API charges only for the tokens used by the API. Before adding Stripe, we must measure token usage for each specific prompt and use it to create the monetization tier. I hope you have experience with that?

routing_warnings.description: The concrete implementation described is the Avelin usage-tracking ledger; Stripe is mentioned only as a downstream dependency.
